title: Consumer contract cases: tests/contracts/<consumer>/*.yaml
description: Written by the consumer (through dev), run by the provider's gate (release.py --check, step 'contracts'). Runner: tests/test_contracts.py; documentation: cli-generator architecture.md, 'Consumer contracts'.

description.description: What the consumer is and what it reads from this tool.

family.description: Column type family: VARCHAR and TEXT are text, BIGINT is integer, TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE is datetime, ...

provider.description: PEP 440 range of provider versions the case applies to, e.g. '<0.7'.

command.description: static: command path, e.g. [db, status]; [] is the root.

options.description: static: options (name or alias) the command has.

exit_codes.description: static: exit codes the consumer handles; each must be documented.

fixture.description: run: the provider's pytest fixture that makes the command run offline.

args.description: run: the arguments after the command name.

output_schema.description: run: JSON Schema of the --json output, only what the consumer reads.
